title: Lamb Stew with Norwegian Flair
description: A hearty, nourishing stew made with lamb, inspired by the flavors of Norway. This dish is perfect for a cold winter's day.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the lamb pieces on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove from pot and set aside.
Add more oil if necessary, then sauté the onion and garlic until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the carrots and potatoes, and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the flour and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Gradually add the broth, whisking continuously. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Return the lamb to the pot, cover, and simmer for 1 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
